resources.string: Enable immersive VR for this instance only. Uses separate instance settings and an adapted OpenGL renderer. Requires the QuestCraft Android/OpenXR build of Vivecraft for the same Minecraft version.

This instance has no active Vivecraft mod. Install the QuestCraft Android/OpenXR build matching its Minecraft version and mod loader, then start again. VR launch is blocked until a compatible build is installed.
This instance has a desktop Vivecraft build. It does not contain the Android/OpenXR loader required by Quest VR. Replace it with the matching QuestCraft Vivecraft build before starting VR.
More than one active Vivecraft jar was found. Keep only the QuestCraft Android/OpenXR build matching this instance. Duplicate Vivecraft mods cannot be launched in VR.
